clips.start_words: It doesn't need to be scoped
clips.send: A daughter sends this to her dad the night before his knee surgery - anxiety that he's agreeing to something he doesn't have to, and hope there's still time to ask.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau tears his meniscus doing drills in Alabama.

The top knee surgeon in town says scope it: 80% recover in six months, his own rate near 90%. Kevin asks one question - without the scope, same rate on its own? Yes, the surgeon says.

So Kevin skips it. Instead: magnet therapy, red light, massage and an oxygen chamber, to bring blood flow back to the area.

Two months later, a second MRI leaves the surgeon stunned. His words: "it's unheard of."

Kevin Trudeau's view: the body repairs itself with enough blood flow and oxygen. Would you ask your surgeon the same question Kevin did?

#kevintrudeau #naturalhealth #kneepain #meniscus #holistichealth #wbdaily

clips.send: A tired friend sends this to someone who reaches for coffee before anything else - a flicker of hope that the fix might be simpler than they think.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau walks through his own morning routine.

He says he falls asleep within minutes, sleeps seven to eight hours straight, and doesn't wake up at night. The moment he's up, before coffee, before anything else, he drinks about 16 ounces of water.

His reasoning: the brain runs on water, so the first thing it needs each morning is hydration, not caffeine.

Kevin Trudeau's view: better sleep and a glass of water before your first cup of coffee can change your energy, your digestion and your mood for the whole day.

What's the first thing you put in your body each morning?

#kevintrudeau #hydration #morningroutine #sleephealth #naturalhealth #wbdaily

clips.send: A parent sends this to another parent buying Halloween candy - anger at finding out the dye is legal here and banned elsewhere.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to a real headline: the FDA moving to outlaw certain food dyes used in candy, soda and cakes.

His point, made for over 30 years before this became news: those dyes are already illegal in other countries. He says the only reason they ever made it into American food was profit, not safety.

Kevin Trudeau's view: a dye banned in one country and sold to kids in another tells you something about who the rules are really protecting.

Next time you check a label, look for the dye, not just the sugar.

#kevintrudeau #fooddyes #labelreading #foodsafety #cleaneating #wbdaily

clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who never questions their yearly check-up - anger at realizing the system was built around profit, not care.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau tells the story of how healthcare became a business.

His account: in the early 1900s, John D. Rockefeller noticed most people weren't going to doctors, so drug sales stayed slow. Kevin says Rockefeller helped found the American Medical Association and backed the drug companies that needed patients walking through the door.

The fix, in Kevin's telling: insurance. Get people to visit a doctor every year, and give doctors a reason to prescribe.

Kevin Trudeau's view: that single idea, more than a century old, still shapes why you go to the doctor today.

#kevintrudeau #healthcare #medicalhistory #naturalhealth #askquestions #wbdaily
